name: secfilingdex
description: EDGAR's database, modernized — programmatic surface over SEC filings

scripts.postbuild: node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap-ai.mjs && npx tsx scripts/ping-indexnow.ts --write-key-only && node scripts/prune-out.mjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf .stale-out-trash .next 2>/dev/null; mv out .stale-out-trash 2>/dev/null && rm -rf .stale-out-trash 2>/dev/null; find . -name '.DS_Store' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -delete 2>/dev/null; find . -type d -name '* 2' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.deploy: npm run clean && npm run build && node scripts/rg-freeze-check.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name secfilingdex --branch main --commit-dirty=true && npm run indexnow
